This pass did not fully cover utilities, turbine OEMs, nuclear operators, copper/wire suppliers, transformer manufacturers, data-center REITs, or grid-software firms; those should be separate Layer 1B passes to avoid overloading the node.

node: Data-center power, cooling, grid connection, and site infrastructure
summary: Expanded universe for the AI data-center physical-deployment bottleneck. The strongest second-order candidates found in this pass cluster around medium-voltage electrical distribution, electrical supply-chain orchestration, mechanical/electrical contracting labor, precision/liquid cooling, and onsite power. These are not buy/sell recommendations; they are research candidates requiring follow-up on backlog conversion, data-center revenue mix, customer concentration, lead times, margin durability, and regulatory/permitting risk.
